calPosts.title: PHI Data Sovereignty: Edge AI Deployment Under HIPAA's Minimum Necessary Standard

calPosts.brief: Examine the tension between AI performance optimization and HIPAA compliance in edge deployments. Focus on data minimization requirements, local processing benefits, and governance frameworks that satisfy both regulatory and clinical effectiveness needs.
calPosts.stat: Edge AI in healthcare can reduce PHI transmission by 85%, but only 19% of health systems have governance frameworks that properly scope minimum necessary data for AI processing
calPosts.cta: How does your edge AI governance handle HIPAA's minimum necessary requirement?
